name: Lindy C Hanley
occupation: Library Tech, Oregon Trail School District

bio.statement: Hanley's pamphlet statement lists prior governmental experience as Sandy City Council since 2024, with liaison roles to the Sandy Mountain Festival, Chamber of Commerce and Library Board.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Sandy City Council, 2024-present; Council Liaison to Sandy Mountain Festival, Chamber of Commerce, and Library Board

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 52 (printed C-51)

bio.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Hanley says she was appointed to the Sandy City Council two years ago.
bio.excerpt: Two years ago, I was honored to be appointed to Sandy City Council.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 52 (printed C-51)

positions.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Hanley says she will pursue every reasonable option to meet wastewater and other infrastructure needs while keeping the financial burden manageable.
positions.excerpt: I will continue to work with Council and city staff to pursue every reasonable option to meet our infrastructure needs while keeping the financial burden we all share as manageable as possible.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 52 (printed C-51)

positions.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Hanley says she wants creative ways to preserve Sandy's heritage and create opportunities for local businesses and tourism.
positions.excerpt: I believe we can find creative ways to preserve and highlight Sandy’s heritage, encourage visitors to explore our community, and create opportunities for local businesses, tourism, and economic development.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 52 (printed C-51)
